meaning:
δια-πρίω
[in LXX: 1Ch.20:3 (סוּר) * ;]
to saw asunder. Pass., metaphorically (vernacular?), EV, cut to the heart: Act.5:33; before τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, Act.7:54.†
(AS)
glosses: members of the sanhedrin were enraged

renderings.bsb: the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged

elsewhere.note: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
